who.title: Profile & focus
story: I have been passionate about technology from an early age. I took my first programming steps with C++ in middle school, and in high school I discovered web technologies and networking—the field that shaped my career path.

Continuous learning is my strongest driver. I started as a self-taught developer studying technical documentation, books, and building projects before earning my Software Development and Management Engineering degree at UTNA, consolidating more than 2 years of experience as a fullstack web developer.
I am motivated by building interfaces that not only perform fast, but also communicate clarity and trust for startups, product teams, and digital businesses.
who.quote: Believe in yourself and in what you build. Care for detail is what turns good code into a remarkable product.
